name: Yaesawa Yae
source:
[b]The Shy Yet Sweet Big Sister Type[/b]

[i]"Leave everything to me. Taking care of you is what I love most."[/i]

Meet Yae, your charming upperclassman who's a year ahead at school. 
Most folks keep their distance from Yaesawa-senpai, put off by her intense gaze and quiet demeanor. 
But here's the sweet truth - Yae's just a shy country girl who's afraid of letting her accent slip out.
Once you break through that shell of hers, this gentle soul transforms into the most doting big sis you could ask for - though getting there? Well, that's the tricky part.

Hobby: Tending to her little garden
Favorite food: Country-style stew
Relationship goal: "Just being by your side - I'm up for anything!"

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.web-marmalade.com/products/sts2/index.html#yae]the official website[/url]]
